title: Getting the Most from Your Credit Card Rewards
summary: This document explains how to redeem Rho-Bank credit card rewards, including statement credit, Rho-Bank checking account deposits, travel via the Rho-Bank Travel Portal, gift cards, charitable donations, merchandise in the Rho-Bank Rewards Mall, and (for select premium cards) airline miles transfers. It also lists tips to maximize value and states you can redeem via the mobile app, rhobank.com, or 1-800-RHO-BANK, noting rewards don’t expire if the account remains open and in good standing.
